mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate indicates a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative during periods of low unemployment (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates increased economic activity, which leads to higher demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth and low unemployment rates indicates a growing economy with high consumer confidence, leading to increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in housing starts indicate an easing monetary cycle and increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high payroll employment rate and low unemployment rate indicate a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer confidence and spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong GDP growth, low unemployment rates, and high housing starts indicates a growing economy with high consumer confidence, leading to increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 2% and UNRATE < 5% and HOUST > 500 and FEDFUNDS < 1%
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
